purpose: Provide content-addressed proof methods for existing canonical ingest assertions so a consumer does not need to re-download every verbose chunk merely to re-prove row counts and exact-file identity already verified mechanically.
design_basis: OCI-style descriptors bind referenced content to digest and byte size.
TUF-style target metadata records hashes and lengths so clients can validate exact target objects from compact metadata.
Git repository metadata exposes immutable blob and tree SHAs without downloading file contents.

must_verify: source chunk count equals source index
source row count equals source item_count
every source row has the indexed column count
mailing projection preserves one row per source row
mailing chunk count equals generated descriptor count
mailing row count equals source item_count

allowed_only_if_all: mailing index contains integrity_attestation with proof_method content_addressed_producer_attestation
current Git blob SHA and size of source manifest exactly match attested descriptor
current Git blob SHA and size of source index exactly match attested descriptor
the exact current source chunk path set equals the attested source chunk path set
every current source chunk Git blob SHA and size exactly match its attested descriptor
the exact current mailing chunk path set equals the attested mailing chunk path set
every current mailing chunk Git blob SHA and size exactly match its attested descriptor
attested source chunk count equals canonical source index count copied into mailing index
attested mailing chunk count equals mailing index chunk_count
canonical manifest/index QA values copied into mailing index satisfy canonical thresholds
consumer_fast_path.proof_semantics: When all exact blob identities match, the producer's direct validation applies to the same immutable bytes currently in the repository. The consumer is verifying identity of already-read exact content, not assuming similarity from filenames or counts.
consumer_fast_path.if_any_check_fails: FAST_PATH_INVALID; fall back to direct canonical ingest if feasible, otherwise fail closed.

generator_must_revalidate_locally: canonical manifest and source index QA
exact manifest and source-index blob identities
exact source and mailing chunk path sets
every chunk blob SHA and byte size
every chunk row_count against producer attestation
source and mailing total row counts
source shortlist tree SHA and mailing tree SHA
runtime_accept_only_if_all: artifact policy_blob_sha equals the already-loaded current canonical policy blob SHA
one current data/production directory metadata read shows manifest blob SHA equals artifact manifest_blob_sha
the same directory metadata read shows shortlist tree SHA equals artifact shortlist_tree_sha
the same directory metadata read shows mailing tree SHA equals artifact mailing_tree_sha
artifact item_count, source_item_count and both verified row totals are equal
artifact source_complete and manifest_complete are true
artifact source_coverage_ratio and manifest_coverage_ratio satisfy canonical thresholds
artifact needs_tuning and manifest_needs_tuning are false
artifact source_to_mailing_row_projection_lossless and all_source_rows_column_validated are true
compact_runtime_validation.runtime_reads: After canonical policy and diagnostic-runner bootstrap, stage 03 normally needs only the compact validation artifact plus one data/production directory metadata read. The full verbose path remains the fail-closed fallback.
compact_runtime_validation.stale_artifact_behavior: Any manifest, shortlist-tree, or mailing-tree identity mismatch invalidates the artifact immediately; do not extrapolate or partially trust it.

diagnostic_stage_03.pass_requires: all canonical ingest QA assertions proven either by compact exact-tree validation, direct content-addressed producer attestation, or direct canonical ingest
